sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, marché mondial des centres de données, 2025, 2026 et 2030

series.nom: Marché mondial du démantèlement informatique des centres de données

2025.texte: Data Center IT Asset Disposition market size has reached to $14.65 billion in 2025

2026.texte: It will grow from $14.65 billion in 2025 to $15.93 billion in 2026 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 8.7%.

2030.texte: It will grow to $21.2 billion in 2030 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 7.4%.
